protocol: Post-exposure review by the same AI reader of every originally unscorable boundary. Enlarged scan context without OCR-box overlays; original core rectangles, identities, tolerance, predictions and available/unavailable slots unchanged. Revised whitespace partitions and explicit unresolved ownership; contact still excludes scoring. Ambiguous interior marks can supply invariant horizontal edges only when every subset between explicit mandatory/possible pixel masks has the same left/right extremes. Original boundary records retained for every reviewed label. Not fresh or independent double annotation.
